title_en: The Stations of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) and Her Oppression in the Sources of the Ahl al-Sunna (Part 8)
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the spiritual stations of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) and accounts of her suffering based on Sunni sources.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Messenger
